findings.finding: Kepler Cheuvreux's Q3 preview nearly doubles its FY26 net-debt estimate to 50M EUR (from 26M) because Esprinet is building inventory to mitigate procurement cost inflation, so the 30 September NFP (a line this name has sold off on) is likely to print worse than the -287.2M EUR of a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (NFP -287.2M, guide confirmed 'upper end') fell -7.63% on 13 Nov 2025; Q3 2024 fell -6.63% on 14 Nov 2024; H1 2026 with NFP stable rose. Cash line not isolable from the other lines.
findings.original_quote: l'accumulo di scorte incide negativamente sulla generazione di cassa, determinando un incremento dell'indebitamento netto. Kepler Cheuvreux ha infatti rivisto al rialzo, quasi raddoppiandola, la stima dell'indebitamento netto per l'intero esercizio 2026, portandola a 50 milioni di euro dai precedenti 26 milioni di euro. [inventory build weighs on cash generation, raising net debt; Kepler nearly doubled its FY26 net debt estimate to 50M EUR from 26M]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: published 4 Nov and the stock is -11% over 20 sessions. Not fully: it is one broker's estimate, the company has not disclosed Q3 working capital, and the H1 release framed NFP as 'stabile' while the other broker (TP ICAP, 2 Nov) still talks of improving cash conversion - if it were fully priced the brokers would agree and the stock would not have bounced +2.3% on 10 Nov.
findings.independence: IDC (8 Oct 2026) says channels 'are now worried about carrying too much inventory', the same mechanism from the market side: https://idc.com/resource-center/press-releases/idc-pc-tracker-3q26

findings.finding: IDC's preliminary Q3 2026 tracker has worldwide PC shipments down 20.1% YoY (62.7M units) after a channel pull-in in H1 ahead of memory-driven price hikes; Screens (PC, tablet, smartphone) is about half of Esprinet's revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 Screens +14% on Windows 11 and memory pre-buying coincided with the +20.65% reaction; H1 2026 Screens +7% with Q2 +4%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public for a month and in every broker preview. What is left is transmission to Esprinet's revenue, which the company itself says is offset by ASP ('il calo delle unità vendute è stato compensato dall'aumento dei prezzi medi', H1 release), so this is a units proxy against a revenue line and sized small.
findings.independence: Kepler's +3.1% Q3 revenue preview (a slowdown from H1 +8%) points the same way: https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/11/04/esprinet-kepler-cheuvreux-taglia-target-price-e-vede-aumento-debito-con-accumulo-scorte-133.html

findings.finding: Ingram Micro, the largest peer with a direct European distribution business, reported Q3 2026 EMEA revenue of $3.9bn, +7.3% YoY, with group revenue +20.8% and next-quarter revenue guidance 11.9% above consensus, i.e. European IT distribution revenue grew in the quarter despite the PC unit collapse.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean read: Esprinet fell -5.13% on 30 Oct 2026, the session after Ingram's print, the same day Citadel's short crossed 0.5% - the market did not take the peer read as positive.
findings.why_not_priced: Kepler's preview of +3.1% Q3 revenue sits below a peer's +7.3% European growth (in USD; currency effect not verified), so if Esprinet tracks the European channel the revenue line may come in above the one sourced estimate; the -5% on the day after Ingram's print says the market did not extrapolate it.
findings.independence: StockStory on the same print: https://stockstory.org/us/stocks/nyse/ingm/news/earnings/ingram-micro-nyseingm-reports-strong-q3-2026-provides-optimistic-revenue-guidance-for-next-quarter (same underlying release, so not independent of the fact, only of the reporting)

findings.finding: The sell-side bar already sits at the top of the raised guide (TP ICAP 82M EUR FY26 EBITDA Adj.; Websim slightly above the 79.5M midpoint) while the 77-82M range implies H2 EBITDA of only 45.1-50.1M against 44.6M in H2 2025, so a plain reiteration of the range is the likely outcome and reads as a non-event or mild disappointment unless management steers to the upper end.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: guidance reaffirmed at the upper end of 63-71M, stock -7.63% next session; H1 2026 raise: +3.3% then +10.9%; Q1 2026 reiteration with strong quarter: +20.65%.
findings.original_quote: TP ICAP Midcap ha rivisto al rialzo le stime di EBITDA rettificato: 82 milioni di euro (+2,5%) nel 2026 [...] Un risultato annuale che si collochi nella parte alta della guidance offrirebbe a Esprinet una solida base in vista del 2027. [TP ICAP raised its adjusted EBITDA estimate to 82M EUR for 2026; a full-year result at the upper end of guidance would give a solid base for 2027]
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is public; what is not is whether management will say 'upper end'. The H1 release's own outlook language ('ricavi ancora in aumento, sebbene a ritmi più moderati'; 'domanda più debole nelle categorie endpoint più mature') is more cautious than a broker at 82M; if the market priced the reiteration risk the brokers would not be sitting at the top of the range. Inference on the bar, so small.
